items.title: Halliburton Secures bp Contract for Deepwater Appraisal Campaign in Brazil
items.summary: Halliburton (NYSE:HAL) has secured an integrated services contract from bp covering the first appraisal campaign at the Bumerangue field in deepwater offshore Brazil. The agreement will see Halliburton provide drilling services and reservoir evaluation as bp advances its appraisal programme for the Bumerangue discovery.

items.title: How Strong Quarterly Results And New Tech Partnerships At Halliburton (HAL) Have Changed Its Investment Story
items.summary: Earlier this week, Halliburton reported quarterly revenue of US$5.71 billion, up 3.7% year on year, with both sales and EPS exceeding analysts’ expectations amid stronger drilling activity and demand for efficiency-focused oilfield technologies. Around the same time, Halliburton Labs expanded its collaborative ecosystem by adding Electroflow, Osmoses, and SiTration, underscoring the company’s support for early-stage technologies in battery materials, resource recovery, and gas separations...
